sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LOW AMPLITUDE...WEAKLY CYCLONIC FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM THE NRN RCKYS ACROSS THE MID/UPR MS VLY TO THE E CST THIS PERIOD...S AND E OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH AMPLIFYING SE ACROSS MB/WRN ONT. FARTHER S...A SERIES OF DISTURBANCES WILL MOVE ESE ALONG BELT OF ENHANCED FLOW EXTENDING FROM WY/CO TO MO/KY. AT LWR LVLS...WNW FLOW ON SRN FRINGE OF MB UPR TROUGH SHOULD STRENGTHEN LEE TROUGH OVER THE DAKOTAS AND THE CNTRL HI PLNS. THE LATTER FEATURE LIKELY WILL SERVE AS THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STRONG TO SVR STORMS THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY SUN. FARTHER N...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO MB TROUGH WILL ENTER ND LATE IN THE DAY.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS TO UPR MS VLY THIS AFTN INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: WEAK SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW ENTERING WY SHOULD CONTINUE SLOWLY ESE INTO THE CNTRL HI PLNS LATER TODAY...ENHANCING DEEP SHEAR AND ASCENT INVOF LEE TROUGH. STRONG SFC HEATING WILL STEEPEN LOW LVL LAPSE RATES ALONG TROUGH...AND LOW LVL MOISTURE WILL INCREASE TO ITS EAST AS SSELY NEAR-SFC FLOW STRENGTHENS THROUGH THE DAY. THIS SETUP SHOULD SUPPORT TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY MID TO LATE AFTN FROM FAR ERN CO NNE INTO WRN/CNTRL NEB AND CNTRL SD. THE INITIAL STORMS LIKELY WILL BE FAIRLY HIGH-BASED AND ISOLD. BUT CONTINUED MOISTURE INFLOW AND EWD MOVEMENT OF UPR IMPULSE SUGGEST THAT CLOUD BASES WILL LOWER AND THAT STORM COVERAGE WILL INCREASE...LIKELY LEADING TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF SEVERAL SMALL CLUSTERS/MCSS BY EVE. AMPLE INSTABILITY /SBCAPE OF 1500 TO 2500 J PER KG/ SHOULD EXIST FOR STRONG UPDRAFTS...WITH LARGE HAIL THE MAIN SVR THREAT. ALTHOUGH 20-30 KT WNWLY 500 MB FLOW WILL KEEP DEEP SHEAR COMPARATIVELY MODEST...VEERING WIND PROFILES MAY SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS BEFORE THE STORMS EVOLVE INTO MCSS. THESE SYSTEMS SHOULD MOVE MAINLY SEWD AND COULD LINGER INTO EARLY SUN AS SSWLY LLJ CONTINUES TO STRENGTHEN IN RESPONSE TO BOTH THE DIURNAL CYCLE...AND TO INFLUENCE OF AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH IN MB/ONT.

sections.title: ND LATE TODAY
sections.text: SFC FLOW WILL BE WEAKER AND MORE VEERED ACROSS ND RELATIVE TO POINTS SOUTH. COUPLED WITH MORE LIMITED MOISTURE...DEEP CONVECTION MAY REMAIN SPARSE UNTIL STRONGER LOW LVL CONVERGENCE/ASCENT APPROACH THE REGION ALONG COLD FRONT LATE IN THE DAY. GIVEN VEERED FLOW AT 850 MB...MUCH OF THE FRONTAL ACTIVITY MAY REMAIN ELEVATED...FORMING ATOP COOL POST-FRONTAL FLOW.

sections.title: GULF STATES TO ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: W-E TROPICAL MOISTURE PLUME WILL SETTLE SLOWLY SE ACROSS THE LWR MS VLY...GULF STATES...AND THE CAROLINAS AS EXISTING RIDGE RETROGRESSES SWWD. SFC HEATING SHOULD SUPPORT ANOTHER ROUND OF SCTD TO NUMEROUS TSTMS IN THE HIGH PW PLUME...ESPECIALLY IN AREAS OF ENHANCED LOW LVL CONFLUENCE ALONG LEE TROUGH OVER THE SOUTHEAST. LOW LVL LAPSE RATES MAY NOT BE AS STEEP AS THEY WERE FRIDAY...BUT SHOULD BE ADEQUATE FOR A FEW STRONG UPDRAFTS AND POSSIBLY A FEW WET MICROBURTS IN THE WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. ..CORFIDI/ROGERS.. 07/10/2010
